metadata.working_research_question: How sensitive is the county-level relationship between reported fixed broadband availability and household-reported wired broadband subscription to the availability-speed definition, socioeconomic context, and ACS sampling uncertainty?
metadata.observational_study_scope: Observational county-level study. No causal claims or direct household-level availability-adoption gap claims.
metadata.temporal_mismatch_disclosure: Census ACS 5-year estimates pool 2020-2024 survey responses. FCC National Broadband Map data is a point-in-time administrative snapshot as of Dec 30, 2025. The FCC file post-dates the ACS window by 12 months.

overall_feasibility_status_rationale: All mandatory input source-integrity checks passed, ACS uncertainty calculation verified, FCC threshold comparison monotonicity verified; alternate-speed input feasibility is complete, while empirical relationship sensitivity analysis has not yet been performed.

sample_definitions.n_3135: 49 states plus Washington, DC, excluding Connecticut and Puerto Rico (N = 3,135). Primary observational study sample.
sample_definitions.n_3213: Those 3,135 matches plus Puerto Rico's 78 municipios (N = 3,213). Sensitivity check sample.
sample_definitions.connecticut_status: Excluded from exact-FIPS matching (0 exact matches between 8 legacy counties in FCC and 9 planning regions in 2024 ACS). No crosswalk created.

mathematical_definitions.numerator_moe_x: B28002_007M (Published 90% margin of error of numerator)
mathematical_definitions.denominator_moe_y: B28002_001M (Published 90% margin of error of denominator)
mathematical_definitions.moe_proportion_formula: MOE(P) = (1 / Y) * sqrt(MOE(X)^2 - P^2 * MOE(Y)^2) [used when radicand >= 0]
mathematical_definitions.moe_ratio_fallback_formula: MOE_ratio(P) = (1 / Y) * sqrt(MOE(X)^2 + P^2 * MOE(Y)^2) [used when radicand < 0]
mathematical_definitions.moe_percentage_points: MOE_pp = MOE(P) * 100 (expressed in percentage points, pp)

uncertainty_propagation.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 'Understanding and Using American Community Survey Data: What All Data Users Need to Know' (ACS General Handbook, Chapter 8: Calculating Measures of Error for Derived Estimates, 2020/2024)
methodological_limitations: First-order Taylor series linearization (delta method) approximates the non-linear proportion function around point estimates.
Pre-tabulated summary tables (B28002) do not publish microdata replicate weights (the 80 successive difference replicate weights) necessary to calculate exact survey covariances.
Substituting published 90% margins of error directly into the proportion approximation may slightly overestimate or underestimate true sampling error in sparsely sampled rural counties.

methodological_risks_and_decisions.title: Alternate FCC Speed Threshold (25/3 Mbps) Validation & Inclusion
methodological_risks_and_decisions.description: The alternate FCC export (25/3 Mbps, Dec 30, 2025) has been validated independently. All 3,234 county entities align perfectly with the 100/20 export with identical unit counts and descriptions. Coverage monotonicity holds across 100% of counties (2,585 higher, 649 equal within 1e-9 tolerance, 0 lower). Alternate-speed input feasibility is complete; empirical relationship sensitivity analysis has not yet been performed.
methodological_risks_and_decisions.recommended_action: Authorize inclusion of 25/3 Mbps coverage in subsequent Phase 4 availability-speed sensitivity modeling, satisfying the approved research question's multi-threshold requirement. Do not infer that the actual empirical relationship has already been evaluated at both thresholds.

methodological_risks_and_decisions.title: Connecticut Geography Policy
methodological_risks_and_decisions.description: FCC data uses 8 legacy Connecticut counties (09001-09015), whereas 2024 ACS uses 9 planning regions (09110-09190). There are 0 exact FIPS matches.
methodological_risks_and_decisions.recommended_action: Formally exclude Connecticut (09) from the primary county-level regression/modeling sample (N = 3,135, representing 49 states plus Washington, DC, excluding Connecticut and Puerto Rico). Connecticut remains excluded from exact-FIPS matching; do not create a crosswalk.

methodological_risks_and_decisions.title: Puerto Rico Geographic Scope Policy
methodological_risks_and_decisions.description: All 78 Puerto Rico municipios match exactly across FCC and Census. However, PR exhibits distinct macroeconomic conditions and telecommunications regulatory frameworks.
methodological_risks_and_decisions.recommended_action: Designate the sample of 49 states plus Washington, DC, excluding Connecticut and Puerto Rico (N = 3,135) as the primary study population, and perform an explicit sensitivity check on those 3,135 matches plus Puerto Rico's 78 municipios (N = 3,213).

methodological_risks_and_decisions.title: ACS Sampling Uncertainty Weighting Strategy
methodological_risks_and_decisions.description: Five counties have negative radicands requiring ratio fallback MOE, and small rural counties (e.g. Loving, TX and Kalawao, HI) show substantial sampling variance (MOE > 30 pp).
methodological_risks_and_decisions.recommended_action: Evaluate whether downstream regression models should utilize Weighted Least Squares (WLS) using inverse-variance weights derived from percentage-point MOE (1 / MOE_pp^2) or household-count weights (B28002_001E) alongside unweighted OLS as a sensitivity check.

methodological_risks_and_decisions.title: Temporal Lag Methodological Caveat
methodological_risks_and_decisions.description: ACS estimates describe pooled 2020-2024 multi-year averages, while FCC reflects a point snapshot as of Dec 30, 2025.
methodological_risks_and_decisions.recommended_action: Explicitly report the 12-month post-period gap in all methodology sections. Do not interpret findings as a concurrent point-in-time equilibrium.
